name: Custom BG Music
description: Replace Geometry Dash's background music with any MP3 from your own music library, without breaking other mods.

library-folder.name: Music Library Folder
library-folder.description: Folder (inside the mod's save data) where your MP3 files live.

enabled.name: Enable Custom Music
enabled.description: Turn custom background music on or off.

apply-to-menu.name: Apply to Menus
apply-to-menu.description: Also replace music in the main menu, not just levels.
